title:
Transforming
Enterprises Through Technology
description:
Vikisol Technologies is a global technology consulting and workforce solutions company, helping enterprises accelerate digital transformation through SAP consulting, software engineering, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, cloud services, and strategic talent deployment.

Founded in 2021 and headquartered at Mindspace, Hyderabad, we have grown into a trusted partner for enterprises, GCCs, and system integrators across India, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, the USA, the UK, and Australia. With 500+ consultants deployed and 100+ projects delivered, we bring enterprise-grade capability with the agility of a focused specialist firm.
subtitle: Trusted by global enterprises for technology, talent, and transformation.
